searchText: <@425572898787426305> regarding your Requests as a sidecar PR, I think you'll find it a blocker to send the hash. <@881905303011086387> already remarked and I definitely agree, that we don't want to send the hash as in the EIP, there is zero reason to force RLP on CL clients, I think we don't even need keccack. So either the EL needs to move to HTR here, or we send the full requests, I understand that this sucks, but we're not in a situation that we would be porting RLP to CL clients I believe. oh, definitely neither porting RLP nor using keccak on CL side. it was proposed to be sha256 of a flat array that would be doable, but that's not what it says in the PR 🙂 But then again, the flat array for us would be the ssz encoding of the think I imagine I think we can probably do the inverse of the json decoding, now that we commited to that, but it does suck cc <@884836500037066862> this would be useful to you https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1288408367068610585/1290993595276460055 there was a discussion earlier today here it happens to be similar (for constant sized request types) in serialization, but with a totally different merkleization. so CL needs to hash twice with different method
